The '''''Dutyfree''''' was a [[GR-75 medium transport/Legends|GR-75 medium transport]] that operated as part of the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Rebel fleet]], serving in several fleet engagements, including the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]. It was commanded by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Areta Bell]] from [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]] to [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].

In 3 ABY, the ship was among thirty medium transports stationed at [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. It was one of the final transports to evacuate the planet, and one of just thirteen transports to reach [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] intact and successfully regroup at the secret [[Haven (rendezvous point)|Rebel rendezvous point]].

==Behind the scenes==
According to ''[[X-Wing: Isard's Revenge]]'', the ''Dutyfree'' is piloted by [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] pilot [[Tarrin Datch/Legends|Tarrin Datch]] through the Imperial blockade, and is escorted by [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] in their [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]]. However, according to ''[[Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back]]'', Datch actually pilots the transport [[Thon's Orchard/Legends|''Thon's Orchard'']], escorted by Antilles in his X-wing and Rogues [[Derek Klivian/Legends|Derek Klivian]] and [[Wes Janson/Legends|Wes Janson]] in a [[BTL-S3 Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL-S3 Y-wing starfighter]].
